title: Cosmic Tree of Life
description: A vibrant red and blue horse with a small red fox riding on its back stands in the foreground. In the surreal desert landscape behind them, a massive ancient tree with gnarled roots and branches forms a cosmic web containing colorful glowing orbs and symbols beneath a starry night sky with a bright central light.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape at night with a massive ancient tree whose branches form an intricate glowing web filled with colorful cosmic orbs and symbols. A bright central light illuminates the scene. In the foreground a vibrant red horse with flowing blue mane stands with a small red fox perched on its back wearing a pearl necklace. Two small human figures stand near the tree roots on sand dunes under a starry sky, in a vibrant fantasy painting style.
